decision.reason: all bounded identifiable families are either argmax-invariant or already fail independent source LOSO; further variants would be metric-guided readout tuning

decision.current_best_action: retain the already accepted bounded local SAM-affinity residual and prioritize benchmarks or authorities with independent identity/extent supervision
